QuestInfo.name: Salad Ingredients
QuestInfo.1: Camila wants to make a healthy Green Mushroom Salad for Maya, and asked you to bring her 10 Green Mushroom Caps.
QuestInfo.2: You went to the #m100020000# in the Singing Mushroom Forest, and returned with Green Mushroom Caps for Camila's cooking.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 300 Can proceed to the Yellowish Green Mushroom Cap quest

0.0: I should get this made right away. Maya looked so sad today...I'm sure a nice salad full of mushroom bits will cheer her right up! You'll give me a hand, right?\r\n

yes.0: Okay, cool! Now, the recipe says...hm...\n#b'Green Mushroom Salad ingredients: Clean Green Mushroom Caps (About 20 - 40)' #k\nRight...Green Mushroom Caps... Please get me 10 of them. That should be plenty, right? Yep, that should be fine. Mm-hm. Take the righthand road out of town to the Singing Mushroom Forest, and you'll find the #m100020000#. I heard that many Green Mushrooms live there.

no.0: I totally thought you would help me... Sigh...

1.0: Thank you so much. I'm sorry I had to ask you this twice... But now I can make a perfect salad! You've saved my salad, #h0#.

yes.0: I can't WAIT to see Maya's happy face! I can only imagine how much she must love salads!

item.0: You can get Yellowish Green Mushroom Caps from the Green Mushrooms at the #m100020000#. I don't know where they hide them, but I KNOW they have them. Bring me 10, okay?
